facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

assets.label: cyclone clusters
assets.service: classification duty on the grinding circuit

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: OEM advisory - CYC-CLASS-A pressurised dual seal support

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on CY-3211 and PT-3211 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. CY-3211 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 November 2024 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting CY-3211 and PT-3211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
